description: Pin a memory to the focus buffer for guaranteed context inclusion (max 3)
embedding_description: Pin a memory to the focus buffer so it always appears in prompt context. Provide memory_id; returns focused_count. Use to keep critical context visible. Max 3 focused memories — unfocus one first if buffer is full.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Confirmation that the memory has been pinned to focus buffer
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.
